description.value: Frederic Wood Theatre is a 400-seat, 1960s proscenium theatre on the UBC Vancouver campus, featuring a fly tower, traps, and a built-in revolve. It is operated by UBC's Department of Theatre and Film and hosts student and professional productions throughout the academic year. Situated near the UBC Rose Garden at the western edge of campus, it is accessible via transit and is one of three performance venues run by the department.
